items.description: People elect presidents to fix problems, not to diagnose their causes

items.description: The potential downgrade by MSCI, an influential index provider, adds to a deepening crisis of investor confidence in the economic policies of Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto.

items.title: Trump Hasn’t Lowered Drug Prices for These Voters
items.description: President Trump has been promoting his efforts to reduce drug prices, but many Americans have not seen relief from rising costs for prescriptions and insurance premiums.

items.title: After Welcoming China’s Electric Vehicles, This Country Is Paying the Price
items.description: Thailand introduced subsidies and tax cuts to encourage electric vehicle adoption. Now it is trying to recalibrate, alarmed by the threat to its industrial landscape.

items.title: Is Longevity Medicine Going Mainstream?
items.description: As major health systems open their own programs, longevity medicine is gaining credibility and becoming more accessible.
